# Operation identity first study

This informed study is not a blind benchmark. Its unchanged first source uses
only zero-qubit Unit owners and existing Op-only calls, including zero and nested
zero powers. The first prediction remains `not-run` history; the separate real
observation records its later execution. The prior CLI accepted four local and
nine bundled roots through 23 native decisions, with zero independent requests.
The checker was unpinned and source preservation was not proved.

The observed Git HEAD and selected prior binary digest are separate identities;
this is not a clean commit-to-binary build attestation. Input, binary and kernel
stability were observed. Full first stdout/stderr are retained. Original Rust
bytes identified in the first plan remain in Git at its observed c14c0cbb commit;
the separate first integrated Rust digest map identifies the later experiment.
Neither map is a proof or a future build attestation.

The distinct-specialization registry counts descriptions; it is not an
executable cache. Regression checks charge its recursive comparisons and retain
both ports, ordered type trees, phase, effect, access, constructors, zero-power
children and issued dependency identities. Independent receipts with equal
matrices remain distinct. Internal optional-inverse controls strengthen complete
identity; the current production constructor fixes one inverse per fresh leaf,
so these controls do not demonstrate a reachable capability-confusion defect.

No generic Basis/Nat admission, dormant evidence discharge, new scoped guarantee,
release approval or full QS/PR/RS/EXACT discharge is claimed. No maximum-size
quantum case is generated or checked. The bounded retention reader never executes
